description: A four state router that steps between neighbouring states on each trigger and passes that state's input through to the output

params.text: Sets the chance of stepping backwards out of that state on the next trigger, 0 to 1
Sets the chance of stepping forwards out of that state on the next trigger, 0 to 1
Attenuates the voltage at the jack beside it before it is added to the large transition knob on that row, 0 to 2

inputs.text: A rising edge here steps the machine to another state or leaves it where it is
The signal passed to the output while the machine is in that state
Adds to the transition knob on that row through the small knob beside it

outputs.text: Carries whichever of the four state inputs belongs to the state the machine is in
Carries 1V, 2V, 3V or 4V for states A, B, C and D

notes: the chance of staying put is whatever is left after the two transition chances; when they add up to more than one they are scaled down and the machine never stays put
nothing moves until a trigger reaches the trig jack, though the output already carries state A's input before the first one
